visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a man and a woman walking toward the camera in an expansive urban plaza. The woman wears a pink checkered shirt, jeans, and sunglasses, holding a takeaway coffee cup. The man, in a black t-shirt and cap, excitedly presents an orange-colored smartphone to the lens. Behind them is the traditional Gwanghwamun Gate under a bright, partly cloudy sky with natural, high-contrast daylight. (2) The perspective shifts to a first-person POV shot from the man's chest-level camera as he follows the woman. He actively lowers the orange smartphone towards the ground, capturing a low-angle perspective of the woman's feet as she walks past a granite bollard near a crosswalk. The camera movement is dynamic, simulating a walking or running motion. (3) The screen transitions into a split-view format. The top half shows the standard camera view, while the bottom half displays a highly stabilized, color-graded 'Apple Log2' preview labeled 'iPhone 17 Pro Max' and 'Activate Mode.' The woman is seen walking across a busy urban crosswalk with numerous pedestrians and vehicles in the background. She eventually turns around to face the camera, smiling broadly as she approaches the lens in a close-up shot, with modern glass buildings and city traffic visible in the background.
